title: Why You Shouldn't Use Sanitary Tees Horizontally
description: A frequent mistake in waste pipe installation is using a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal drainage line. Sanitary tees are engineered specifically for horizontal-to-vertical transitions, directing wastewater downward into a vertical stack. When installed horizontally, the short sweep fails to direct the solid waste properly, often causing solids to settle, creating chronic blockages, and interrupting proper venting flow. For horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe connections or directional changes, use a combination wye and eighth bend or a long-sweep turn to maintain fluid velocity and prevent waste buildup. Always check local plumbing codes for approved fitting applications.
